entities.summary: Innocent III, a notable figure in the history of Holy See, associated with Avignon Papacy & Great Western Schism (1198–1303). Preceded by Albigensian Crusade and Fourth Crusade. Their legacy influenced Fourth Lateran Council – pinnacle of medieval papal authority and Papacy moves to Avignon – 'Babylonian Captivity' begins.
